tldr: Mercury in the 1st house routes the mind and voice through selfhood and embodiment.
body: With Mercury in the 1st house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through identity, body, presence, and first response to life. This makes how you enter the room, claim space, and let the world meet you a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through selfhood and embodiment.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in selfhood and embodiment.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
